name: How much does it cost to frame an interior partition wall?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to frame an interior partition wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Non-load-bearing partition wall costs depend on total linear footage, ceiling height, whether sound insulation is included, and door rough-ins. Pricing scales higher when mechanical trade rough-ins are required inside the cavities. Framing alone represents only the initial structural step; drywall hanging, taping, texturing, painting, and baseboard installation represent additional scope. If your project involves moving plumbing lines, adding dedicated electrical outlets, or adjusting HVAC ducts into the new partition, trade coordination directly influences overall project estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on wall length, ceiling height, door openings, and whether electrical, plumbing, or soundproofing insulation must run through the framed stud bays.
